home.title: Home
home.intro: Your starting point for local discoveries and shared moments.

home.flashEmpty: Live Flash alerts are not available yet.

home.radarBody: A new way to uncover local gems. Radar challenges are not available yet.

explore.title: Explore Local
explore.intro: Discover local places, hidden gems and the neighborhoods around you.

explore.radarBody: Radar discoveries and activity heat signals are not available yet.

explore.suggestBody: Propose a missing place with its name, category and location. Review will be required before publication.
explore.reportBody: Flag an incorrect name, location or hours, a closure or a duplicate. Approved corrections will belong to Places.

explore.pendingBody: This feature is preserved in the roadmap. Its real behavior will arrive in a later stage.

share.title: SHARE GOOD VIBES
share.intro: Share the moment. Feel the city together. Right now.
share.shotBody: Capture a local moment when safe media handling and its privacy rules are ready. The camera is not opened here.
share.checkBody: A targeted vibe challenge. Capture, response timing and proof rules still need an approved contract.
share.flashBody: A spontaneous sharing window, distinct from VibeCheck. No live timer or alert is running here.
share.feedEmpty: Nearby shared moments are not available yet. No live people or posts are displayed.
share.compassBody: Follow your curiosity through local places. Personalized vibe matching comes later.
share.circlesBody: Recurring interest circles and spontaneous gatherings will need real membership and community tools.
share.supportBody: Community support is preserved as an idea. Donations and financial transactions are not available.

vibe.title: VIBE
vibe.intro: Your space for connections, conversations and shared local energy.
vibe.gossipBody: Updates from followed people, mutual matches and your own posts will appear here after social features are ready.
vibe.driftBody: Discover interest rooms and meet people with shared interests. Rooms and conversations are not available yet.
vibe.vibesBody: Mutually agreed connections will appear here. Matching and challenges are not available yet.
vibe.orbitBody: People you choose to follow will appear here once account and social graph features are ready.
vibe.echoBody: People who follow you will appear here once account and social graph features are ready.
vibe.quote: Find your people. Share the moment.
vibe.soundBody: Room sounds and voice sharing are preserved for a later Messaging and Media stage.
vibe.pullsBody: Your incoming VibeCheck invitations will appear here.

purse.title: PURSE
purse.intro: The home of your future VQ ledger and peer exchange experiences.

purse.ledgerBody: No verified transactions are available. Future rewards need their own real ledger.
purse.tradesBody: Peer offers and trading remain product goals. No offers, escrow or trade rooms are active.
